title: Remote runs fail 'Still connecting to the remote engine' after the Pod's ComfyUI restarts; tester's Pods drop mid-session
description: BREAKS USERS (Fabio 2026-09-30, the photographer tester on 1.6.2 too). Fabio's dev app, Pod 3j9el86ykarqpw (L4, EU-RO-1, Secure Cloud, wrapper 0.2.45): Klein 9B install on the Pod -> remoteComfyNeedsRestart -> Pod ComfyUI restarted 17:40:53Z (Pod /internal/logs) -> kleinEdit failed 17:41:08Z 'Still connecting to the remote engine' (comfyController._ensureRemoteReady WS gate, ensureWsConnected 15 s); retry 17:43:32Z failed the same with NO restart. app.log has no 'WebSocket error' line at all. At 17:44Z a Node WebSocket to wss://<pod>-8889 and -8188 opened in ~220 ms and /health said ready + comfy_ready, so the Pod and RunPod's proxy were fine: the renderer's socket state is wedged (candidates: an OPEN socket with _wsReady false that connect()'s same-engine reuse branch never re-flips; or a handshake stuck CONNECTING that ensureWsConnected never replaces). Needs the renderer console (asked Fabio) to pick. Tester's 'connects then suddenly disconnected' may be a second cause: the wrapper watchdog (idle_timeout_s 600) stops an idle Pod; needs his <install>\user-data\logs\app.log.
